input.body_text:
Four new members joined the NSC board

Newsletter, February 16, 2026

Welcome New Board Members

On February 1st we had our annual meeting at the Heritage Hall. You can read more about the meeting below, but I would really like to thank Ingrid Larsen for having been our president for the past three years. Even though being president is somewhat of a marathon, Ingrid did an amazing sprint towards the finish line by being in charge of, and putting together, an amazing 75 year anniversary party back in October. Thank you Ingrid!!!

I would also like to welcome four new people to the board, Maria Holm, David Berg, Sara Lind and Nina Dahl. Thank you all so much for stepping up and wanting to help run the club. We've already put a number of new exciting events on the calendar, so save the dates, for those that are still being worked out.

Finally I'd like to remind everyone that the whole Pine Lake Cabin is available for rent for only $100 per night during the winter. I spent this long weekend up there with a number of friends and it's a great and different experience to visit the cabin in the winter. We now have three bedrooms with beds for 8 people, and with a fire in the fireplace you get some truly Scandinavian hygge. There's also plenty of things to do and explore around the lake, so check it out, you can't find a better deal!

Erik Sandberg (your new/old president)
Ps. On Friday Jan 30 we had a fun Full moon hike. Great to see so many people joining on short notice.

Annual Meeting at Heritage Hall - Feb 1, 2026

Before we dove into the official business, the afternoon kicked off at 1:00 PM with a social hour. About 40 people showed up and it was fantastic to see so many familiar faces and welcome several newcomers over drinks and mingling. Upcoming Events

Happy Hour Above the City in the Skyline Tower

February 19

Join Nina and Mary for a truly special NSC Happy Hour experience, one you won’t want to miss. This February, we’re heading inside the iconic Skyline Tower for exclusive access to a 48th-floor bar with breathtaking views of the bay.

When: Thursday, February 19, 5:30 PM
What: Evening Happy Hour (timed entry required)
Where: Skyline Tower – 48th Floor

This event is by registration only and must be coordinated directly through Mary in advance! Due to building security, all guests must be checked in at a designated arrival time to gain access upstairs.
Available arrival time slots:
• 5:30 PM
• 6:00 PM
• 6:30 PM
If you’re interested in attending, you must RSVP online under the following link, where you can also read more details: https://rsvp.example.com/e/nsc-happy-hour

March 19th: NSC Happy Hour at The Copper Kettle

NSC Happy Hour at The Copper Kettle – Join us on Thursday, March 19th, from 5:30 PM at one of the city’s most unique cocktail bars. Enjoy exclusive drink specials, a cozy vintage atmosphere, and some of the best Aquavit in town, courtesy of owner Paul’s Danish roots. Great drinks, great vibes, and great company and live music—don’t miss it!

March 28th: NSC Bus Trip to Wine Country (save the date)

Bus trip to wine country, details coming soon.

April 4th: Joint NSC-NHC Easter Luncheon (Save the date)

Come join the NSC and NHC for a traditional Scandinavian Luncheon. More info to follow. If you would like to help out organizing this event, please fill out this form.

April 5th: Joint NSC-NHC Kids Easter & Crafts (save the date)

Kids and family friendly event at the Nordic Heritage Center

Mountain cabin reservations

The mountain cabin winter reservations have now been open for a while, and we are seeing a lot of bookings come in. To make the system as fair as possible for everyone, we want to kindly remind everyone about the booking rules:

- Single membership allows you to make reservations for ONE room, ONE stay at a time. Once your stay is over, you can then make your next reservation.
- Family membership allows reservations for TWO rooms, ONE stay at a time, i.e. on the same dates.
- We do not allow multiple reservations for different dates. Once your current reservation is over, you can go online and book your next one.
- IMPORTANT: You do need to make sure that you include the correct # of people that will stay in each room in the reservation. If you need to add extra people to the reservation, email info@nordicsocial.example.org, and let us know what the adjustment should be. Note that there is a max # of individuals allowed per room, as outlined in the room descriptions on the reservation page.

Please email cabin@nordicsocial.example.org if you have any questions about the cabin or the reservation system.

Nordic Social Club

Riverside, CA 90000
